run.llm_note: All role/classification/confidence/rationale decisions below were made by LLM analysis (glm-5.3) of the real source code at the cited locations; this file records the per-batch, per-raw-row decisions and the dedup mapping for audit.

batch_policy.rationale: batches grouped by module/service so each batch shares one code context; every batch was reviewed against the real source file before labeling

dedup.key: sources: (file, line, callableName, argIndex); sinks: (file, line, callableName)
rules: source rows of the same (file, line, callable, argIndex) merged: the BinaryExpr and StringLiteral extraction shapes of one route/handler parameter are the same source site
sink api + ast rows of the same call site merged (os.path.join, os.open/fdopen, json.loads, ZipFile, Popen members)
repeated rows of the same call site merged (server/filter.py:766, augment_store.py:181-183)
same-line distinct callables kept separate (fdopen/open/join at server/filter.py:772 and :773; exists and join at test_utils.py:51)
no raw row was dropped without a mapping - every row resolves to an entry below
